LEGENDKEEPER.ServiceUrlHint: 127.0.0.1 works only when this browser is on the Foundry host. A remote browser needs the authenticated HTTPS address of the companion service.
LEGENDKEEPER.AutomaticSyncHint: Stays off until both the live API round trip and the Foundry sheet test have passed, and you turn this on.
LEGENDKEEPER.LiveProofHint: Turn this on only after npm run live-api and npm run live-foundry have each passed. A unit test or an HTTP connection is not either gate.
LEGENDKEEPER.PollIntervalHint: How often the paired GM renews the leader lease and checks LegendKeeper. Limited to 60–120 seconds.
LEGENDKEEPER.Migrate: Assign block ids and refresh the baseline
